title: Fs.F_OK, fs.R_OK, fs.W_OK and fs.X_OK have been removed
summary: Node.js removed fs.F_OK, fs.R_OK, fs.W_OK and fs.X_OK (DEP0176: documentation-only since v20.8.0, runtime deprecation since v24.0.0, end-of-life since v25.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of fs.F_OK, fs.R_OK, fs.W_OK and fs.X_OK with fs.constants or fs.promises.constants.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
